description: Get the calling org's current-period usage and plan limits (agents, calendars, events, API calls, webhook deliveries, webhook endpoints, availability queries, iCal subscriptions, proposals, recurring events, booking pages, scoped keys, holds, cross-calendar queries) and when the monthly counters reset (resets_at, 00:00 UTC on the 1st). Requires an Organization key (chr_sk_*); Agent keys cannot read org-wide usage.
name: get_usage
